misconceptions.description: Believing data is neutral and objective.
misconceptions.trigger: learner says 'the model just reflects reality'
misconceptions.feedback: Data reflects choices about what to collect, how to label it and who is included. Those choices shape results.

misconceptions.description: Assuming labels are always correct and agreed.
misconceptions.trigger: learner ignores who labelled the data
misconceptions.feedback: Labels are human judgments. They can be inconsistent or reflect the labellers' assumptions.
